anyOf.description: Only when the paper asks to DRAW a bar graph / histogram / line graph the memo marks by T C L S P: the graph is BUILT on the phone step by step. want: the right type; groups: the X categories in order; answers: each group's value; x / y: the axis label choices, the right one FIRST; capWords: groups of words, the caption needs one word from each; okSteps: Y-axis steps the memo accepts

Only for a MONOHYBRID genetic cross the memo marks P1 phenotypes, P1 genotypes, gametes, F1 genotypes, F1 phenotypes, ratio (compulsory), P1/F1, meiosis/fertilisation: BUILT on a Punnett square. alleles: the system's alleles; phenos: every phenotype the stem names; parents: the two P1 parents; offspring: EVERY possible genotype with its phenotype. The criteria keep the memo's 8 points
